reference.title: Гончар за кругом
reference.subject: potter's hands cupping a small clay bowl, fingers seen from the side
reference.interest: Изучить захват и положение больших пальцев
reference.view: Framing from wrists to rim; side view with the near thumb separated from the bowl

reference.title: Щенок потягивается
reference.subject: a puppy stretching forward with its hindquarters raised
reference.view: Low side view with all points of contact visible

reference.title: Каменная арка в разрезе
reference.subject: side view of the joints and blocks in a low stone arch
reference.view: Near profile; keep the stone joints readable from the spring line to the crown

reference.title: Папоротник снизу
reference.subject: underside of a fern frond with its leaf joints exposed
reference.interest: Увидеть, как отходят листочки от стебля
reference.view: Under the frond, with the junctions backlit and no view of the pot

reference.title: Окно мастерской
reference.subject: a workbench and two open window panels in an ordinary repair shop
reference.interest: Сравнить дневное освещение двух оконных створок
reference.view: View from the end of the bench, with a readable sill and one clear daylight source

reference.title: Колено в согнутой позе
reference.subject: seated figure with one knee drawn up, loose work trousers and a plain wall
reference.view: Three-quarter side view at seated eye level; separate the ankle and supporting knee

reference.title: Пустая сумка
reference.subject: a collapsed canvas tote, its seam and two straps visible
reference.view: Frame the tote flat from above, one strap free and the other following the sag

reference.title: Велосипедная втулка
reference.subject: a bicycle wheel hub and a short section of its spokes
reference.view: Oblique close crop with one flange sharp and a short run of alternating spokes visible

reference.title: Рогоз на берегу
reference.subject: stalks and seed heads of cattails at the edge of a pond
reference.interest: Сравнить толщину стеблей и профиль семенных головок
reference.view: Side view against open pond water, letting individual stalks separate naturally

reference.title: Куртка на спинке стула
reference.subject: a heavy jacket draped over a straight chair back
reference.interest: Увидеть, где стул удерживает вес куртки
reference.view: Side view at shoulder height; the backrest shows where the heavy fabric changes direction

reference.title: Кусок кирпича
reference.subject: one chipped brick showing its broken pores and layered edge
reference.interest: Сравнить пористый разлом и гладкую грань
reference.view: Raking side light travels across one broken face and the intact corner

reference.title: Клешня краба
reference.subject: a crab claw and its visible hinge against a neutral surface
reference.view: Single claw in profile, hinge in focus without the rest of the animal

reference.title: Крыша павильона
reference.subject: a small market pavilion roof from below, exposing rafters and fasteners
reference.view: View from beneath one corner, keeping the rafters and two fasteners legible

reference.title: Кухня перед завтраком
reference.subject: corner of an ordinary kitchen, a single mug and an unmade table
reference.interest: Изучить поведение мягкого утреннего света в кухне
reference.view: Standing eye level from the doorway; window light reaches the table one side at a time

ambiguous.title: Корни в глинистом обрыве
ambiguous.subject: exposed roots in a clay bank, their branching outline hovering between a bare tree and a standing figure
ambiguous.interest: Человеческая фигура читается только в разветвлении корней
ambiguous.view: Frame the bank frontally; keep the apparent shoulders inside the outline of the roots

ambiguous.title: Складки светлой ткани
ambiguous.subject: off-white cloth folds loosely suggesting the planes of a turned face
ambiguous.interest: Намёк на лицо возникает из светотени ткани
ambiguous.view: Let one ridge suggest a brow in oblique light; other creases remain cloth

ambiguous.title: Каменная гряда
ambiguous.subject: two weathered rocks whose shared contour faintly resembles a curled animal
ambiguous.interest: Читается общая поза спящего зверя без деталей
ambiguous.view: Frame two rocks low against the horizon so their joint outline suggests a curled back

ambiguous.title: Тень лестничных перил
ambiguous.subject: overlapping cast shadows from stair railings suggesting an unknown figure in passing
ambiguous.interest: В наложении теней угадывается движение человека
ambiguous.view: Frame only the wall and crossing shadows; let a break in their edges interrupt the resemblance

ambiguous.title: Край низкого облака
ambiguous.subject: edge of a low cloud bank with a profile that almost resembles a long-bodied animal
ambiguous.interest: Профиль облака напоминает животное лишь местами
ambiguous.view: Let the suggestion appear at one edge of the cloud while the rest disperses

ambiguous.title: Неровный берег
ambiguous.subject: an irregular shoreline and its reflection, together suggesting a second landscape inside the first
ambiguous.interest: Из берега и отражения возникает иной возможный пейзаж
ambiguous.view: Frame across the waterline so the reflection interrupts, rather than mirrors, the shoreline

ambiguous.title: Следы на мокрой бумаге
ambiguous.subject: a few connected water stains on paper whose edges briefly suggest a bent figure
ambiguous.view: Keep the bent contour readable in one patch, with bare paper between the other transfers

ambiguous.title: Кора старого дерева
ambiguous.subject: overlapping strips of bark suggesting a profile only at one angle
ambiguous.interest: Кора напоминает профиль при одном угле освещения
ambiguous.view: Use a close oblique view; side light picks out one ridge while the surrounding bark stays legible

ambiguous.title: Выгнутая полоса песка
ambiguous.subject: a wind-carved sand ridge with a silhouette between a wing and a folded piece of cloth
ambiguous.interest: Гребень песка балансирует между тканью и крылом
ambiguous.view: Frame along the ridge and use a short shadow to separate its lip from the flat sand

ambiguous.title: Тень от комнатного растения
ambiguous.subject: a houseplant's fragmented shadow faintly resembling a hand or a bird wing
ambiguous.view: Only part of the shadow falls into the frame; the leaf gaps suggest either fingers or a wing

ambiguous.title: Морщина на фольге
ambiguous.subject: one crumpled foil ridge and its highlight, an almost mountainous profile
ambiguous.interest: Горный контур угадывается в одной морщине фольги
ambiguous.view: Use raking light on a close crop; the foil grain remains visible beside the ridge

ambiguous.title: Сходящиеся ветви
ambiguous.subject: two branches crossing, with an uncertain animal-like gap between them
ambiguous.interest: Животное угадывается в просвете между ветвями
ambiguous.view: Frame the crossing branches against a clear sky, keeping the suggestive gap open

ambiguous.title: Отпечатки краски
ambiguous.subject: two soft-edged paint transfers with one recognizable silhouette emerging where they overlap
ambiguous.interest: В месте нахлёста двух отпечатков появляется возможный силуэт
ambiguous.view: Keep both transfer shapes soft and leave the suggestion at their shared edge

ambiguous.title: Обломки мела
ambiguous.subject: three chalk fragments and an intervening shadow with a faint profile resemblance
ambiguous.interest: В короткой тени обломка мела угадывается профиль
ambiguous.view: A low side view follows the cast shadow; reveal only part of its hint of a profile

ambiguous.title: Механизм с рычагами
ambiguous.subject: two crossing levers and a hinge whose outline suggests an insect only from the side
ambiguous.view: Frame the hinge and two crossed levers at an angle; the likeness stays in their silhouette

ambiguous.title: Профиль крыши
ambiguous.subject: an ordinary roof and side wall that briefly suggest the outline of a head
ambiguous.interest: Здание на мгновение читается как голова
ambiguous.view: Frame the roofline in profile against open sky; let the facade remain an ordinary building

process.title: Рябь под дождём
process.subject: small rain rings intersecting and dissolving across a puddle
process.interest: Увидеть, как круги сталкиваются и теряют форму
process.view: Look down near the edge of the puddle; show intersections between a new ring and two fading ones

process.title: Свет через рифлёное стекло
process.subject: light refracted through ribbed glass into uneven bright strips
process.interest: Различить преломление света и ритм полос
process.view: Frame across the ribbed pane and the patch of wall where its light bends
process.minimal: Keep the two clearest bands on the wall and enough of the pane to show where they come from

process.title: Иней на металлической сетке
process.subject: frost crystals spreading unevenly along a wire mesh
process.interest: Разобрать рост кристаллов от поверхности проволоки
process.view: Use close side light to show where crystals grow out from the mesh

process.title: Дым над погасшей спичкой
process.subject: a thin trail of smoke breaking into several soft curls
process.view: Keep the match at the bottom edge; show the direction of the transparent plume against a darker field
process.minimal: Reduce the plume to the point where the first bend in the smoke fades into the background

process.title: Трещина в высыхающей глине
process.subject: drying clay with short branches breaking away from one irregular crack
process.interest: Рассмотреть разветвление трещины и корки глины
process.view: Low light across the clay; follow one fracture from a wide split to a hairline

process.title: Плавающее отражение
process.subject: vertical window reflections stretched and interrupted by gently moving water
process.interest: Увидеть, как волна прерывает вертикальное отражение
process.view: Use a low oblique view with one straight reflection interrupted at two heights

process.title: Скользящая тень
process.subject: the soft and hard edges of a cast shadow meeting across a bent sheet
process.interest: Сравнить мягкую и резкую кромки тени
process.view: Fold the sheet across one diagonal, allowing the same shadow to change softness on either side

process.title: Пар на холодном стекле
process.subject: condensation beads collecting into a few tiny tracks on glass
process.interest: Различить отдельные капли и следы их слияния
process.view: Look across the pane in grazing light, where two small tracks gather several droplets

process.title: Движение ткани
process.subject: successive soft folds along the edge of a cloth lifted by the wind
process.view: Frame along the cloth edge, with the largest fold near the point where wind lifts it

process.title: Пятно пигмента в воде
process.subject: pigment spreading through water, leaving a dark concentration and thin translucent edges
process.interest: Сравнить плотный центр пигмента с прозрачным краем
process.view: Use a side-lit close view of the spreading front; keep one pale tendril and a clear boundary with water

process.title: Полосы от жалюзи
process.subject: parallel bands of light bending halfway across a textured corner
process.interest: Проследить перелом световых полос на углу
process.view: Frame the corner so the change of angle is visible in consecutive bands

process.title: Пена у кромки воды
process.subject: flecks of foam joining and breaking apart against wet sand
process.interest: Увидеть, как островки пены распадаются на кромке
process.view: Use an oblique view along the wet sand to follow one continuous edge into broken flecks

process.title: Снежная крупа на стекле
process.subject: fine grains of melting snow with tiny refractions at their edges
process.view: Close view at the point where a sharp grain becomes a shallow clear drop

process.title: Туман вдоль дороги
process.subject: a strip of fog gradually obscuring regularly spaced roadside posts
process.interest: Понять, как теряется контраст в тумане
process.view: Use receding roadside posts as a scale for visibility; let farther poles disappear in stages

finished.title: Ансамбль из чашек
finished.subject: a small imaginary orchestra assembled from chipped porcelain cups
finished.interest: Собрать фарфоровые формы в странный ансамбль
finished.view: Group the cups in three height tiers; reserve the strongest accent for one cracked rim

finished.title: Дежурный на крыше
finished.subject: an odd rooftop attendant looking after a flock of paper birds
finished.interest: Показать фигуру и птиц на общем силуэте крыши
finished.view: Low horizon and enough space between roof edges to read the flock

finished.title: Рынок на причале
finished.subject: an evening market set up on a narrow pier, bright crates stacked against dark water
finished.interest: Соединить ритм ящиков с глубиной воды
finished.view: View along the pier; crate edges recede while one strip of dark water stays open

finished.title: Сад на полке
finished.subject: a tiny garden cultivated in drawers pulled halfway open
finished.interest: Связать открытые ящики в один маленький сад
finished.view: Use a front view with one shallow drawer leading the eye up to two deeper ones

finished.title: Танец в прачечной
finished.subject: two people dancing among rows of round washing-machine doors
finished.interest: Поставить пластичные фигуры против круглых дверец
finished.view: Look slightly from the side; a clear gap between the dancers separates the gesture from the machines

finished.title: Ночной кондуктор
finished.subject: a conductor punching tickets on a nearly empty tram with patterned upholstery
finished.view: View down the aisle; repeat seat patterns without merging them into the conductor

finished.title: Птица из газет
finished.subject: a bold collage of a bird built from torn blocks of newsprint and enamel color
finished.interest: Собрать силуэт из разных краёв газетных вырезок
finished.view: Keep the longest torn edge against an open patch of background

finished.title: Лестница в проволоке
finished.subject: a graphic maze of stairways with two figures crossing on different levels
finished.interest: Показать два уровня движения в лестничной сетке
finished.view: Keep the two figures at different heights and repeat the main stair angle

finished.title: Аквариум в книжном шкафу
finished.subject: an illuminated fish tank tucked among uneven shelves in an ordinary room
finished.interest: Сделать аквариум единственным источником света на полке
finished.view: Use the side of the shelf to catch a band of spill light and leave the book rows legible

finished.title: Отражение ярмарки
finished.subject: a painterly fairground reflected in the wet asphalt after closing
finished.interest: Связать ярмарку и отражение через цветовые пятна
finished.view: Let the reflection occupy the lower half, breaking up the brightest spots on the ground

photo.name: Документальная фотография
photo.text: documentary photograph with natural local light, ordinary surface detail and no retouching

macro.name: Натурная макрофотография
macro.text: close observational photograph revealing fine material structure

graphite.name: Карандаш, графит
graphite.text: graphite on matte paper with pressure variation and rubbed construction marks

ink.name: Тушь
ink.text: brush and nib ink with varied line weight and irregular pooling

watercolor.name: Акварель
watercolor.text: transparent watercolor with damp edges and exposed paper between washes

gouache.name: Гуашь
gouache.text: matte gouache with visible brush joins and uneven block edges

pastel.name: Пастель
pastel.text: dry pastel on toothy paper with pigment caught in the grain

charcoal.name: Уголь
charcoal.text: charcoal values with lifts from a kneaded eraser

linocut.name: Линогравюра
linocut.text: hand-pulled linocut with blunt cuts and uneven ink pressure

monotype.name: Монотипия
monotype.text: rough monotype transfer with torn patches and changing ink pressure

collage.name: Коллаж
collage.text: cut-paper collage with slightly misaligned cut edges and old paper textures

digital.name: Цифровая графика
digital.text: flat digital shapes with visible construction seams and limited colors

ballpoint.name: Шариковая ручка
ballpoint.text: ballpoint marks that double back, with unequal stroke density

crayon.name: Восковые мелки
crayon.text: wax crayon with uneven pressure and small unfilled gaps

palettes: warm paper, graphite grey and charcoal
indigo, steel blue and pale ice
near black purple, peach and green
linen grey, stone and wood tones
dusty pink, faded brick and deep plum

object_studies.title: Лёд и обрывок упаковки
object_studies.subject: a melting ice cube beside a torn paper wrapper
object_studies.interest: Посмотреть, как прозрачная капля меняет читаемость рваной кромки
object_studies.view: Set the wrapper on a tilted window ledge and the ice just uphill; frame only the contact where the water reaches the torn edge

object_studies.title: Перо и чайное ситечко
object_studies.subject: a striped feather held below a tea strainer
object_studies.interest: Сравнить прожилки пера и сетку, глядя сквозь ситечко
object_studies.view: Look through the mesh at the feather behind it, with the feather shaft still visible past the rim

object_studies.title: Катушка на краю скола
object_studies.subject: a spool of blue thread beside the chipped edge of a brick ledge
object_studies.interest: Сопоставить параллельные нити со сколами кладки
object_studies.view: Place the brick edge almost against the crop; the fine loose thread remains visibly separate from the larger nicks in the ledge

object_studies.title: Галька и чашка в просвете
object_studies.subject: a smooth pebble and a handleless porcelain cup
object_studies.interest: Увидеть смещение контуров через прозрачное отражение
object_studies.view: View the pebble on a narrow glass shelf from below; the cup stands on the sill beyond it, seen partly through the glass and partly in reflection
